short_scenes.caption: Zor.
short_scenes.narration: It was Zor. The strongest warrior of Mia's tribe. And the man her father had promised her to.

short_scenes.caption: "She is mine."
short_scenes.narration: Mia belongs to me, Zor growled. Come home now, or this stranger dies.

short_scenes.caption: She made a choice.
short_scenes.narration: Mia looked at John, wounded and weak. Then she looked at Zor. And she made a choice.

short_scenes.caption: "Then you'll both burn."
short_scenes.narration: She stayed. Zor's face went dark. Then you will both pay, he said, and vanished into the night.
